reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must refuse a report group in which an entry with a LINE NUMBER clause (format 1, 2 or 3) has any subordinate entry, at any depth, that also has a LINE NUMBER clause, whether the clause is absolute, PLUS or with NEXT PAGE, while sibling LINE clauses and a LINE on a format 3 entry under a format 1 entry without one stay legal.
reader.edition-search: ScreenReportLineNesting and its caller (line 680) contain no Edition.DialectLevel, CobolVersion, ConstructRegistry or ReservedWords reference; the rule is applied identically at every edition (pb565 witness refuse-at 85, 2002, 2014, 2023).
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb565 covers LINE PLUS inside LINE PLUS (format 2 in format 2); format 1 over format 2, format 1 over format 3, format 2 over format 3, NEXT PAGE, the legal sibling and cross-group cases are not exercised

reader.notes: The flat-array walk stops at the first entry whose level is not greater, so it reaches every subordinate entry and no sibling or later group. The message cites only §2023:13.18.35.3 SR4 at --std 85 (citation blemish).

refuter.evidence: Attack: a LINE two levels below the LINE-bearing entry through an intermediate format 2 entry without LINE (01 TYPE DE LINE PLUS 1 / 03 USAGE DISPLAY / 05 LINE PLUS 1 COLUMN 1 PIC X(2)). Probe r4 -> COBOL2199 at the 05 entry, exit 65: the walk reaches every depth of subordination. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR9 'must not have a subordinate entry that also contains a LINE NUMBER clause'.
